message.content:
Sure! To post a comment to an IP address on VirusTotal V3 you just need to send a **POST** request to the `/ip_addresses/{id}/comments` endpoint with your API‑key in the `X‑Aptoken` header (or `x-apikey`, depending on the version) and the comment data in the body.

Below is a quick reference you can copy into a terminal or adapt to whatever HTTP client you prefer.

---

### Example – Using *curl*

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash

IP="192.168.1.1"
APIKEY="<your_api_key_here>"   # <-- put ABC321 here when running locally

JSON='{
    "data":{
        "type":"comment",
        "attributes":{
            "text":"Confirmed #malware"
        }
    }
}'

curl -sS \
     --request POST \
     --header "Accept: application/json" \
     --header "Content-Type: application/vnd.api+json" \
     --header "x-apikey: $APIKEY" \          # <- API key goes here
     --data "$JSON" \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/${IP}/comments"

echo ""
```

#### What each part does

| Part | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `--request POST` | Tells the server you’re creating a new resource. |
| Headers (`Accept`, `Content-Type`) | Tell VT you’ll receive & send JSON formatted per RFC 7807 / JSON‑API spec. |
| `x-apikey` | Your personal API token (replace `<your_api_key_here>` with “ABC321” before executing). |
| Body (`$JSON`) | Contains the comment type + text exactly as required by VT’s schema. |

If everything works, you’ll see a response similar to:

```json
{
  "data": {
      "id": "...",
      "links": { ... },
      "relationships": { ... },
      "type": "comment",
      "attributes": {
          "created_at": "...",
          "updated_at": "...",
          "text": "Confirmed #malware"
      }
  }
}
```

That confirms the comment was added successfully!

---

### Quick checklist

1. **Replace** `<your_api_key_here>` with your real key (“ABC321”) only on your local machine—never share it publicly.  
2. Make sure the IP address matches the one you intend to annotate.  
3. Verify that the API key has permission to write comments (some free tiers may restrict certain actions).

Feel free to tweak the script or integrate it into your own tooling. If you hit any errors, let me know what the error message says and I can help troubleshoot further!
